content.comment_body: Hello forum, I haven't programmed with [product_name] in some time, but needed to develop a small program for a mask making machine. After finishing my program, I attempted to transfer it to the controller but encountered an error (see attached image). Can anyone advise on possible causes and solutions?
Could you provide additional information? Specifically, which [product_name] model are you using and what version of [product_name] software is installed?
Thanks for your prompt reply. I resolved the issue by uninstalling the previous software and installing the latest version of [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced a communication error when attempting to transfer a program to a controller using [product_name] software.
